additive_attribution.group_excess: For each comparison and group g, delta_g = ||r_left,g||_2^2 - ||r_right,g||_2^2.
additive_attribution.positive_share: max(delta_g,0) divided by the sum of positive group excesses in the same rig and grouping; positive totals and cancellation fractions are retained separately for camera, component and frequency groupings because aggregation can change cancellation.
additive_attribution.camera_grouping: Nine active canonical camera blocks, each summing both detector components and all 16x16 pixels.
additive_attribution.component_grouping: Two detector components, each summing all nine cameras and all 16x16 pixels.
additive_attribution.frequency_transform: Orthonormal separable type-II DCT independently on each 16x16 camera-component residual image.
additive_attribution.camera_localization_statistic: sum of the three largest camera positive shares
additive_attribution.tie_break: Priority order above; descriptive top groups use lowest flat group index on exact ties.

independent_validation.formal_implementation: Vectorized orthonormal DCT matrix products and NumPy grouped reductions on the sealed formal residual replay.
independent_validation.independent_implementation: Direct cosine-basis scalar loops and explicit grouped sums on the separately sealed independent residual replay; do not import the formal analysis module or runner.
independent_validation.energy_array_relative_definition: maximum absolute element difference divided by the larger whole-array maximum absolute value; near-zero individual groups do not define the scale

decision_order: Any parent identity, shape, finite, metric replay, Parseval, additive closure, source, input, output-seal, formal-independent numeric, or discrete-classification mismatch gives INCONCLUSIVE_INVALID_CASE19_OBSERVATION_EXCESS_ATTRIBUTION_V259.

If at least 10 of 13 rigs have camera top-three positive excess share >=0.75, conclude POST_OPEN_CASE19_CAMERA_LOCAL_OBSERVATION_EXCESS_V259 and allow exactly one separately frozen deployment-visible camera-local mechanism diagnostic.

Otherwise, if at least 10 of 13 rigs have dominant component positive excess share >=0.75, conclude POST_OPEN_CASE19_COMPONENT_LOCAL_OBSERVATION_EXCESS_V259 and allow exactly one separately frozen component-local mechanism diagnostic.

Otherwise, if at least 10 of 13 rigs have dominant frozen frequency-band positive excess share >=0.75, conclude POST_OPEN_CASE19_FREQUENCY_LOCAL_OBSERVATION_EXCESS_V259 and allow exactly one separately frozen residual-spectral mechanism diagnostic.
Otherwise conclude FAIL_CASE19_DIFFUSE_OBSERVATION_EXCESS_ATTRIBUTION_V259 and close the current heat/Krylov residual-repair family without another candidate.
stop_rule: No v259 result is an initializer, predictor, accuracy pass, exact-call reduction, speedup, external confirmation, or real-BOST result.
